explanation: The name of the king of Babylon in the book of Daniel, also known as Belshazzar.
Mysterious signs that suddenly appear on the wall during a feast at Belshazzar's palace, which no one can interpret.
The prophet who is the main character in the book and who is called to interpret the writing on the wall.
The first word of the writing on the wall, meaning that God has numbered and weighed Babylon's king and found him wanting.
The second word of the writing on the wall, meaning that the king has been weighed and found wanting.
The third word of the writing on the wall, meaning that the kingdom will be divided and given to the Medes and Persians.
The peoples who take over Babylon after the writing on the wall is interpreted and assume power from the Babylonians.
